# Stella Maynard

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c11 P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 c16 P4](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** Student and former schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c9 P9](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0009), [v2 c11 P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Stella is a very pretty girl with a vivid, black-eyed beauty.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Stella is a thoughtful, imaginative, and ambitious girl who possesses a heart full of wistful dreams and fancies. Though she has a lively sense of fun and enjoys lighthearted moments with her friends, she can also be subject to moods of weariness and discouragement. She holds high ideals and is deeply affectionate toward her close companions.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c16 P31](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0031), [v2 c16 P35](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0035), [v3 c9 P16](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0016)_

## Traits

- Thoughtful  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

- Ambicious  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching  <sub>[v2 c9 P9](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0009)</sub>

## Goals

- To pursue higher education at Redmond College rather than continue country schoolteaching  <sub>[v2 c9 P9](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0009), [v2 c9 P11](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0011)</sub>

## History

Stella Maynard attended Queen's Academy alongside Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant, where she became part of their close-knit circle of friends. After graduation, she taught at a country school for two years, experiencing all the trials and humorous tribulations of a young teacher. Weary of boarding and country schoolteaching, she decided to resume her studies at Redmond College to complete her Arts degree. She proposed that she, Anne, Priscilla, and Philippa Gordon rent a house together in Kingsport, bringing her Aunt Jamesina to keep house for them. The girls established themselves at Patty's Place, where Stella shared a room with Priscilla. At Redmond, Stella maintained a good all-round academic standing and graduated with her B.A. degree. After graduation, she accepted a position teaching in Vancouver.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c9 P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 c9 P8](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0008), [v2 c9 P12](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0012), [v2 c9 P13](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0013), [v2 c10 P33](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0033), [v2 c16 P0](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0000), [v3 c1 P10](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0010), [v3 c9 P29](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0029), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029)_
